useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

enforceSameDetectedClass.description: Whether to consider the class of the box AND its coordinates or just the coordinates.

penalizeExtraBoxes.description: Whether or not to account for extra unmatched boxes in the IOU score.

title:
{@link MlAsymmetricMeanIouMetric} computes the Intersection Over Union between two lists of {@link BoundingBox}.
It does not make any assumption on the cardinality and ordinality of the lists.
Instead, a best effort box to box matching algorithm (quadratic time complexity) is implemented.
name: MlAsymmetricMeanIouMetric
